name: Mystic Destinies: Echoes
source:
Become Aurelia, a rare winged Sylph of Avalon who makes her living as an information broker in the red light district of Yoru. Despite Aurelia’s job, she prefers to live life as peacefully as possible— unless there’s an adventure involved. In her past lies many exploits, some so old they’re nearly forgotten, and some so fresh she can still feel the chills. But there’s one Aurelia cannot forget. One that has come back to haunt her.

In the dark depths of the mythical ruins of Atlantis, Aurelia and her best friend—known as the “Pirate Queen” Pax—searched for both knowledge and treasure. But when Aurelia unleashed something far beyond their realm of comprehension, the two barely managed to escape with their lives.

When Pax one day comes crashing through Aurelia’s window, only managing to whisper “...that thing...it’s back”, it’s with a resigned and grim determination that she takes on the task of correcting her mistake from the past. Having to choose between having the world obliterated or attempting to save it at the cost of their own lives, the two gather up an assortment of some of the most dangerous people in Yoru. It’s together with these men that they set off to try and stop the ancient and immensely powerful threat.

But how do mortals even begin to stop a power that presides over all creation?

How can mere mortals stop the power of Chaos?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=40423]Lemmasoft thread[/url]]
translation:
成为Aurelia，一名稀有的阿瓦隆翼灵。她在Yoru的红灯区靠做情报掮客为生。尽管从事着这样的工作，Aurelia仍更愿意尽可能平静地生活——除非有冒险在等待她。她的过去充满了许多冒险，有些古老得几乎被遗忘，有些却新鲜得仍让她感到战栗。但有一件事，Aurelia永远无法忘记，那件事又回来纠缠她了。

在亚特兰蒂斯神话遗迹的黑暗深处，Aurelia和她最好的朋友、被称为“海盗女王”的Pax一起寻找知识与宝藏。然而，当Aurelia释放出远超她们理解范围的某种存在时，两人勉强逃过一劫。

一天，Pax从窗户撞进Aurelia的房间，只来得及低声说：“……那东西……回来了。”Aurelia带着认命而阴沉的决心，承担起弥补过去错误的任务。两人必须在让世界毁灭与牺牲自己拯救世界之间做出选择，于是召集了Yoru最危险的一群人。她们与这些男人一同出发，试图阻止那股古老而强大的威胁。

然而，凡人究竟要如何阻止统治一切创造物的力量？

区区凡人，又要如何阻止混沌之力？

（来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=40423]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]）
